subject: bald head, front view, neutral expression (hair not built on this head: ignore hair, compare only the face)
reference_style: Monster Hunter Stories 3 (MHS3) anime toon style, adult male (Leo)

eye_size.reference: Almond eyes, each about 0.33 of the pupil-to-chin distance wide; opening height about 0.55-0.6 of its width.
eye_size.ours: Almond eyes, each about 0.35 of the pupil-to-chin distance wide; opening height about 0.55 of its width.

eye_spacing.reference: Pupils about 0.72 of the pupil-to-chin distance apart; gap between the inner corners about 1.3 eye widths.
eye_spacing.ours: Pupils about 0.73 of the pupil-to-chin distance apart; gap between the inner corners about 1.2 eye widths.

iris.reference: Tall oval green iris about 0.45 of the opening wide and the full opening tall, cut by the upper lid; dark green top, mid green middle, a lighter green lower crescent, a dark outline, a tall dark pupil set high, two thin dark arcs on one upper side, small light cross-shaped sparkles in the lower half, one white teardrop highlight at the iris edge on the viewer's right.
iris.ours: Tall oval green iris about 0.45 of the opening wide and the full opening tall, cut by the upper lid; dark green top, mid green middle, a lighter green lower crescent, a dark outline, a tall dark pupil set high, two thin dark arcs on the upper side toward the highlight only, small light cross-shaped sparkles in the lower half, one white oval highlight at the iris edge on the viewer's right.

sclera.reference: Near-white eye whites (about sRGB 230,228,227) with no grey band.
sclera.ours: Near-white eye whites (about sRGB 230,228,227) with a faint cool shade right under the upper lid.

lash_line.reference: Dark-brown upper lid line, thin over the eye and thicker with a short wing at the outer corner; only a thin line under the outer half of the lower lid.
lash_line.ours: Dark-brown upper lid line, thin over the eye and thicker with a short wing at the outer corner that wraps a little under the outer corner of the lower lid.

brows.reference: Brown brush-stroke brows with darker hair strokes, angled down toward the nose, close above the eyes, thick at the inner end and thinning toward the outer end.
brows.ours: Brown brows with thin dark diagonal hair strokes, angled down toward the nose, close above the eyes, thin at the inner end, thickest about a third of the way out, thinning to the outer end past the outer eye corner.

nose_mouth.reference: No nose line in front view, a pale highlight on the bridge, a small soft shadow under the tip about 0.49 of the pupil-to-chin distance below the pupils; a thin dark mouth line about 0.5 wide at 0.64-0.67 below the pupils with a soft shadow under the lower lip.
nose_mouth.ours: No nose line in front view, a pale highlight on the bridge, a lens-shaped brown shadow under the tip about 0.50 below the pupils; a thin dark mouth line about 0.5 wide at about 0.66 below the pupils with a brown shadow under the lower lip.

jaw_chin.reference: Face narrowing from the cheekbones to a short, squarish chin about 0.37 of the pupil-to-chin distance wide at the bottom.
jaw_chin.ours: Face narrowing from the cheekbones to a rounded-square chin about 0.33 of the pupil-to-chin distance wide at the bottom.

ears.reference: Ears partly hidden by hair; the visible ear sits close to the head, its top level with the brows, the inner ear shaded darker.
ears.ours: Ears fully visible (no hair), standing out from the head at about 20 degrees, top level with the brows, bottom level with the nose shadow, a large mauve-brown inner shade.
